item.description:
### Added - Live CPU die temperature (°C) on the dashboard CPU card, coloured green→red by how hot the machine is and flagging throttling, with the same reading pinned just below CPU in the menu bar - New status-bar dropdown visuals: dual 30s rolling wave graphs for E/P core clusters, GPU utilization vs. GPU memory, live GPU memory in use, system load averages, and a color-coded memory breakdown (Wired, Active, Compressed, Free)
### Changed - Status-bar dropdown is grouped into clean CPU, GPU, MEMORY, and SYSTEM sections with centered titles and airy spacing - Update checks now run hourly instead of once a day
### Fixed - Lighter background footprint: with the dashboard closed, the sampler no longer spawns `top`/`iostat` on every tick, and the status bar skips redundant redraws
